description: UART ports made at run time as providers: a port with its id, rate, format and pins, framed (a link to another board) or raw (a GPS, a sensor on a stream's binding). A port is removed with the provider's REMOVE.

commands.label: Create a UART port
commands.description: A UART of the ESP32-S3 as a provider on two pins: its write makes it (its GPIO device must exist), its read answers what it was made with. The console's port and the board's link are not made so.

fields.label: Provider
fields.description: Its id, chosen here: any the board has not given

fields.label: UART
fields.description: The UART of the chip to make: not the console's, not the one the board's link uses

fields.label: Baud rate
fields.description: Any rate from 1200 to 5000000 (250000 for DMX, 31250 for MIDI)

fields.label: Mode
fields.description: Framed: a session can attach it (a link to another board); Raw / Raw lines: the bytes as they are, for a stream's binding or a typed command; Direct: a device driver writes and reads it itself, for exact timing

fields.label: Parity
fields.description: The parity bit

fields.label: Stop bits
fields.description: 1 or 2; the data bits are 8

fields.label: TX
fields.description: A pin of the ESP32-S3 itself

fields.label: RX
fields.description: A pin of the ESP32-S3 itself

fields.label: RTS
fields.description: With CTS: hardware flow control; leave both unused for none

fields.label: CTS
fields.description: With RTS: hardware flow control; leave both unused for none

fields.label: UART
fields.description: The UART made by CREATE

commands.label: Send a command
commands.description: Sends bytes on a raw provider and answers with what comes back, in one request, as I2C's RAW does: a command typed to a GPS or a LoRa module. Refused while something else reads from the provider. The board runs no other normal command while it waits.

fields.label: Provider
fields.description: The provider's id: a raw one

fields.label: Wait
fields.description: How long to wait for the answer; 0: only sends

fields.label: Answer at most
fields.description: A longer answer is cut

fields.label: Data
fields.description: The bytes that go out, as they are (runs to the end of the frame)

returns.label: Answer
returns.description: The first message that came back, empty when nothing did

commands.label: Wait for a message
commands.description: Answers with the first message that comes on a raw provider. What comes between two of these is not seen: to follow a device that talks by itself, use an In stream.
